relationships.description: The license declares the legal terms of use that apply to the API contract described by the OpenAPI document, attached to that document through its Info object.
relationships.evidence: The openapi.yaml/json file contains an info.license block with a name (and optionally url or identifier) nested under the root document's info object.

notes: Structurally, License is nested inside Info, which is composed into OpenAPIDocument, so this is really transitive containment. A composes relationship from License to Info, or reached through Info, would be more precise. A direct associated-with link to the document is redundant if the Info-to-document composition is already modeled.
